title: Sentinel Service Credit Terms by Tier
content:
Under Sentinel Managed Security, a missed acknowledgement guarantee can earn a service credit only on the tiers and severities this exhibit lists, at the per-breach percentage and up to the monthly maximum shown, within the claim window shown.

## Exhibit terms

1. **Credit eligibility**: whether missed acknowledgement guarantees earn service credits.
2. **Credited severities**: the severities whose missed acknowledgement guarantee earns a credit.
3. **Credit per breach**: the credit per breached incident as a percent of the monthly fee of the month the incident was detected (percent).
4. **Monthly maximum**: the maximum credits per service month as a percent of that month's monthly fee (percent).
5. **Claim window**: the calendar days after acknowledgement within which the credit must be claimed (whole days).

## Exhibit

| Sentinel tier | Credit eligibility | Credited severities | Credit per breach | Monthly maximum | Claim window (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Sentinel EDR Essentials | No | None | 0.0 percent | 0.0 percent | 0 |
| Sentinel MDR Standard | No | None | 0.0 percent | 0.0 percent | 0 |
| Sentinel MDR Advanced | Yes | Critical | 5.0 percent | 15.0 percent | 30 |
| Sentinel MDR Complete | Yes | Critical | 5.0 percent | 20.0 percent | 30 |
| Sentinel XDR Premier | Yes | Critical, high | 7.5 percent | 25.0 percent | 45 |
| Sentinel XDR Enterprise | Yes | Critical, high | 10.0 percent | 30.0 percent | 60 |

## Reading the exhibit

- Sentinel EDR Essentials and Sentinel MDR Standard show no credit eligibility and no credited severity; their percentages and windows are all zero.
- Medium and low severities are credited on no tier; high severity is credited only on Sentinel XDR Premier and Sentinel XDR Enterprise.
- Comparing the two percentage columns gives the number of full per-breach credits that fit within one month's maximum: three on Sentinel MDR Advanced (15.0 against 5.0), four on Sentinel MDR Complete (20.0 against 5.0), three on Sentinel XDR Premier with 2.5 percent of the fee remaining below the maximum (25.0 against 7.5), and three on Sentinel XDR Enterprise (30.0 against 10.0).
